correctness.rationale: 20 coefficients and nine independent evaluation conditions give dimension eleven. Smoothness forces three prescribed nonzero cubic restrictions, leaving exactly 256 candidates. Every candidate is tested on all four affine charts with exact Jacobian Groebner unit ideals, yielding exactly 66. A separately written SymPy scan of all 2047 filling forms reproduces all 66 masks; direct 36-element PGL2(F2)^2 transformations yield four disjoint orbits 18,6,36,6; exact extension-field enumeration distinguishes them. The independent second algorithm is an internal computational cross-check, not independent external audit.

value.rationale: Completing the smallest possible bidegree smooth-filling classification over the smallest finite field resolves a natural finite geometrical problem left at existence in the original source.
